name: adx_trend_strength_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus
thesis: ADX rising above 25 from below signals the emergence of a new intraday trend. Rather than using ADX just as a filter (as in strategy 21), here ADX itself IS the signal. When ADX(14) crosses above 25 AND +DI > -DI (for longs) or -DI > +DI (for shorts), a new directional trend is forming. The edge exists because ADX measures trend strength regardless of direction, and the cross above 25 is a relatively specific event (~2-3 times per day per stock). The DI lines provide direction while ADX provides conviction. The inefficiency is that most traders use ADX as a lagging confirmation, not as a lead entry signal. By entering when ADX is just crossing 25 (nascent trend), we capture the early part of the trend before it becomes obvious to all participants.
stock_filter: ADV(20) > 40 crore INR AND close > 100 INR

long.confirmation: ADX(14) still rising (ADX[t] > ADX[t-1]) on the bar after crossing 25

short.confirmation: ADX(14) still rising (ADX[t] > ADX[t-1]) on the bar after crossing 25

entry.entry_price: market order on confirmation bar close

exit.stop_loss: 0.25% from entry OR ADX drops below 20 (trend failed to develop)
exit.trailing_stop: trail at 0.2% once profit exceeds 0.3%; widen to 0.3% if ADX > 40
exit.signal_exit: exit if ADX starts declining AND DI lines converge (trend fading)

risk.position_sizing: fixed 1L; increase to 1.5L if DI spread > 20 (strong directional conviction)

filters.vix_filter: no specific filter — ADX-based entries work across VIX regimes
filters.time_filter: no entries before 09:45 (ADX needs warmup) or after 14:45
filters.trend_filter: DI spread > 10 ensures genuine directional bias, not noise
other_filters: skip if ADX has crossed 25 and fallen back below 25 twice in last 60 bars (false breakouts)

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — ADX is widely known but the specific entry on ADX crossing 25 with DI confirmation is less common

weaknesses: ADX is inherently lagging — by the time ADX crosses 25, the trend has already started 14+ bars ago
On 1-min bars, ADX(14) reacts to only 14 minutes of data, making the 25 threshold potentially unstable
False ADX breakouts above 25: ADX can spike above 25 on a single large bar and immediately fall back
prior_art: ADX/DMI system by Welles Wilder ('New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems', 1978). Standard textbook trend following. The ADX > 25 threshold for trend confirmation is widely used. Using ADX cross as entry rather than filter is less conventional — most sources use DI cross for entry and ADX for filter.
notes: Edge math: 0.47 * 50bps - 0.53 * 28bps = 23.5 - 14.8 = 8.7 bps gross. Costs ~11 bps. Net ≈ -2.3 bps. Marginally negative. If the DI spread filter (>10) pushes win rate to 0.50: 0.50*50 - 0.50*28 = 25 - 14 = 11 bps gross, net 0 bps. Breakeven. Needs additional edge from trailing stop capturing outsized winners in strong trend days.
